design.scope: NR LDPC coded AWGN code-block BLER, not PDSCH transport-block BLER
design.evm_model: effective linear SINR = 1/(1/raw linear SNR + EVM^2)
design.caution: Search noise and code-block/TB distinction require independent validation before paper-level BLER claims.
design.threshold_estimator: binomial maximum-likelihood logistic fit over all search and check points; requested BLER crossing
